entries.target_full:
Machine World: Loreilal
A world with an advanced mechanical civilization that creates mechanical soldiers and other machines.
This affinity has the most offensive summons. They are powerful, but their MP costs are also somewhat higher.

record.source_visible:
「機界ロレイラル」
機械兵士らを生み出す
高度な機械文化が
発達している世界。
攻撃召喚が最も多い属性。
威力も高いが消費ＭＰも若干高い。
record.target_full:
Machine World: Loreilal
A world with an advanced mechanical civilization that creates mechanical soldiers and other machines.
This affinity has the most offensive summons. They are powerful, but their MP costs are also somewhat higher.
record.notes: Full meaning draft; original 200x136 image is not an English length budget. Proposed glossary spellings require review. No omission to fit.

reviews.note: Pass: advanced mechanical civilization and mechanical soldiers are retained; most offensive summons, strong power, and somewhat higher MP costs are all present. Other machines is a reasonable rendering of the nonexclusive example marker, not a new species claim.

entries.target_full:
Yokai World: Silturn
A world where humans coexist with supernatural beings such as yokai, dragon gods, and oni gods.
Its summons mainly attack or apply status ailments and possession effects. Many of these effects put enemies at a disadvantage.

召喚がメイン。異常・憑依効果は
敵を不利にするものが多い。
